proof_and_scope_audit.reason: One desk owes dated coupons/face plus a separately settled European put. The curve is built only from default-free instruments; the alternative reserve issuer does not cancel client liabilities. Values add by linearity, without needing independence. Dates, currency, volatility/rate units, trading permissions and unweighted path evidence are explicit.

The positive triangular cash system uniquely identifies the three exact discounts. Independent simultaneous row reduction and exact repricing agree. Holding payment-date zeros matches the fixed cash; selected interpolation is an assumption and forwards are not labeled physical expectations.

Differentiating the finite discounted cash sum gives key and parallel exposures. Two independent equations determine barbell quantities. The exponential Taylor remainder is explicit for each node shift; positive common-shift curvature is not claimed to hedge a twist or supply a missing payment. The barbell is a comparator, while matched zeros are the chosen reserve.

The first curve segment alone gives the constant rate for the entire option horizon. The exponential Ito calculation and finite Gaussian second moment support the discounted-stock true martingale. The PDE and put boundary/terminal conditions are stated with Chapter8 interior regularity, admissibility and linear-growth uniqueness scope. No new general stochastic-rate or stochastic-volatility theorem is asserted.

Each tree has strict d<R<u and immediate exercise cash at allowed adapted dates. Finite backward induction bounds and attains every policy value. European, Bermudan and all-node values are compared on the same law. Changing step count changes the law as well as exercise opportunities, and no general monotone CRR convergence or continuous-American claim is made. Root continuation holdings are not recommended after exercise.

Plain/control use4096 ideal independent observations; antithetic uses2048 pair units at the same standalone payoff count. Fixed beta=-.5 is chosen in the inputs, not trained on evaluation observations. Expectation and covariance formulas are derived; a valid wrong-sign beta can increase variance. The estimators share inputs and are not treated as independent repetitions.

Analytic, Simpson and independent adaptive payoff integration are separated from tree approximation and sample uncertainty. The bounded-put normal-tail bound is valid under the ideal law, but the Simpson difference is not called a certified quadrature error. Fixed-n CLT and Hoeffding assumptions are explicit. Controlled payoffs are not given a false bounded-payoff concentration interval. A finite hash-generated pseudo experiment is not claimed to prove continuous iid coverage.

Every initial, interior and liquidation trade debits the bank; maturity payoff is separate, with no undefined maturity Greek. Independent discounted gains telescope to terminal error. Zero-cost minus with-cost error equals terminalized costs because the delta rule does not depend on account balance. Fixed unweighted paths neither estimate an expected P&L nor justify substituting a continuous variance-mismatch formula.

Adding initial cash b shifts every terminal error by b/D(T) for the unchanged policy. Hence the positive-part buffer exactly meets the declared worst-tested loss allowance. It is not an all-path superhedge, optimal strategy or unique market price; fees and loss capital remain distinct. The total quote budgets max(riskless fixed-liability PV, actual selected reserve purchase PV) before adding the put and buffer: an expected saving never reduces the floor, while any selected premium must be financed at time zero.

Default precedes its coupon, recovery is a fraction of face at its own settlement date, and only earlier coupons survive. The pricing probability is exogenous. In the baseline the reserve discount equals the Q-expected dated loss, while the full default loss is much larger. The signed apparent saving can instead be negative when early full-face recovery makes the reserve more expensive than the riskless promise. The funding ledger retains the first missed coupon, bridge interest and terminal deficit; negative bank balances do not establish an available facility.

All five classroom gates remain conjunctive. A numerical pass cannot waive a reserve cash deficit or changed exercise rights. Passing the limited demonstration still requires separate real-world contracting, funding, implementation and model evidence; the project makes no real approval, empirical adequacy or legal-compliance claim. Future/default-only reserve excess does not finance initial purchase or the hedge in survival; the early-full-recovery counterexample now fails the funding gate at an inadequate quote.

limitations: The reference model is an original synthetic teaching construction, not empirical validation or a real financial recommendation.
The numerical domain is bounded and meaningfully tested, not exhaustively enumerated. Transcendental bits may differ at final rounding across platforms.
The ideal iid continuous-normal experiment differs from the finite deterministic pseudo generator; neither seeded interval inclusion nor fixed-n sampling bounds establish empirical pricing accuracy.
Scenario hedge buffers cover only the supplied histories and unchanged delta policy. No all-path guarantee, optimal hedge or commercial acceptance follows.
The two-state credit model does not infer a physical hazard, calibrate dependence, prove borrowing availability or specify actual documentation.
Separate peer/coordinator review, volume integration and whole-edition visual/mobile/keyboard/print QA are separate remaining gates.
